    tf.metodo_pago,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', fecha_transaccion) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN monto ELSE 0 END) AS ingresos_mes_actual,
    SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', fecha_transaccion) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' THEN monto ELSE 0 END) AS ingresos_mes_anterior
FROM 
    transacciones_financieras tf
WHERE 
    tipo IN ('ingreso_reserva','ingreso_consumo','ingreso_adicional')
GROUP BY 
    tf.metodo_pago;
